candidate_as_built.explanation: The grey-green paint is consistent and clean across all views, with clear hardware and dark trim details visible in the detail block.

candidate_aged.explanation: The aged state shows convincing broad paint retention with irregular edge corrosion and rust runs, though the top view shows a slightly blocky dust pattern.

locker_as_built.explanation: The reference locker presents a highly polished and uniform finish with sharp edges and clear material separation in the detail view.

locker_aged.explanation: The aged locker features realistic weathering with distinct rust streaks and hardware corrosion that matches the brief's requirements.

legacy_as_built.explanation: The legacy finish is functional but appears slightly flatter in the top view compared to the more defined relief of the candidate and locker.

legacy_aged.explanation: The legacy aged state shows significant wear but lacks the subtle dust softness and specific rust-run directionality seen in the other finishes.

grey-green_paint.observations: The base color is a consistent grey-green across all as-built states, matching the warship steel brief.

bare_hardware.observations: Hardware is visible as distinct metallic elements in the detail block, appearing bare and uncorroded in the as-built state.

dark_trim.observations: Dark trim is visible along the bottom edges and door frames in the hero and front views of the as-built state.

edge_corrosion.observations: Irregular rust and corrosion are clearly visible on the corners and edges of the aged candidate and locker.

rust_runs.observations: Narrow downward rust runs are visible on the vertical faces of the aged locker and candidate in the front view.

settled_dust.observations: A fine, soft dust layer is visible on the upward-facing top surfaces in the top view of the aged states.

faded_fabric.observations: No fabric pads are visible in the provided views of the locker or candidate.

findings: The dust pattern on the top view of the candidate aged state appears slightly blocky and could benefit from more organic noise.
The legacy aged finish lacks the specific directional rust runs present in the candidate and locker, making it look less weathered.
The relief on the as-built legacy finish is less defined than the candidate, particularly in the top view.
limitations: The provided views do not show the interior back of the locker or any potential fabric pads, so those features could not be evaluated.

acceptance.rule: candidate aged >= locker aged in this review, numeric gates pass, all four view blocks inspected; wardrobe must also match or exceed its per-face finish in this review
